## First graph

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

storms |>
  filter(year == 2000) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = wind, y = pressure, color = status)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title = "Storms in 2000", x = "Wind (mph)", y = "Pressure (mb)")
```
